The '''KD-24 Auditory Provocation Drone''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that was used by the freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]. It was equipped with sonic devices designed to attract and provoke local wildlife, and KD-24 drones were deployed to sic animals on individuals who were intruding on the Shroud's business.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
KD-24 Auditory Provocation Drones appear as enemies in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. One of three types of droids that will attack players who use [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] to scan the Shroud's transmitters, the KD-24 will appear on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" />
